philosophy.title: Stop Renting Intelligence. Own Your Intelligence.
philosophy.description: Swarm Agentic Lab does not offer fixed subscription tiers or one-size-fits-all pricing. Our platform serves as the central control plane for organizations building large-scale agent ecosystems and AI-powered operations.

pricing_factors: Number of agents and workflows required
why_no_fixed_plans: Designed for deployment within your environment
limits: There are no predefined public limits on active agents, workflows, or execution capacity. Capacity planning and deployment architecture are designed around your specific use case and infrastructure requirements.
